description: This file defines the Network class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, which implements a JSONRPC server for network-related functionalities such as interface management, ping, trace, and IP settings. It includes method declarations, event handlers, and class members related to network operations.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: A class implementing a JSONRPC server for network management, inheriting from PluginHost::IPlugin and PluginHost::JSONRPC, providing methods for network interface control, ping, trace, and event handling.

methods.description: Retrieves network quirks or capabilities.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is enabled.

methods.name: setInterfaceEnabled

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the default network interface.

methods.name: setDefaultInterface
methods.description: Sets the default network interface.

methods.name: getStbIp

methods.name: getApiVersionNumberWrapper
